author: P2-Tracker-BES-SW
body: #### PR description: This PR is mainly the full package for - packer/unpacker in OT system : `EventFilter/Phase2TrackerRawToDigi` where `ClusterToRawProducer` packs cluster and `RawToClusterProducer` unpacks MC or cosmic-rack data back into clusters - packer/unpacker in IT system : `EventFilter/Phase2PixelRawToDigi` where `PixelToBitStreamProducer` encodes. digis into chip bitstreams, `PixelToBitStreamProducer` packs the RAW, and `RawToPixelProducer` unpacks and decodes it back into digis. One minor change along with this PR is the `TrackerDetToDTCELinkCablingMap` where we added one more info class for inner tracker cabling maps `ModuleInfo`. TODO : There are private db files which we are in discussion with DPG so that we can remove the db files before we merge this PR. IT has to be removed before the PR merge #### PR validation: Just adding two examples, that OT and IT packer and unpacker lets you retrieve its original form input
title: Phase2 IT and OT packer/unpacker udpates from backendsystems SW group
